# Jordy Support

> Free guides to using AI agents for research, writing, and everyday work. All guides and downloads are accessible without payment or signup. Personal services are optional.

## Learn

- [Start here](https://jordysupport.com/getting-started/): Choose a setup and try a small task.
- [How agents work](https://jordysupport.com/fundamentals/): Context, tools, memory, and permissions.
- [Sharing files](https://jordysupport.com/fundamentals/is-it-safe-to-let-ai-read-your-files/): Review access and data handling.
- [Why AI makes things up](https://jordysupport.com/fundamentals/why-ai-makes-things-up/): Check claims against evidence.
- [Tokens and limits](https://jordysupport.com/tokenomics/): Understand context and usage.

## Practice

- [Prompting](https://jordysupport.com/prompting/): Clear tasks, source material, and review criteria.
- [Playbooks](https://jordysupport.com/playbooks/): Four repeatable tasks with examples and free ZIPs.
- [Automation](https://jordysupport.com/automation/): Plan, test, and monitor recurring work.
- [Troubleshooting](https://jordysupport.com/troubleshooting/): Investigate problems in order.

## More

- [Downloads](https://jordysupport.com/downloads/): Playbooks, VALE, and self-hosted TUSK.
- [VALE](https://jordysupport.com/vale/): Windows voice assistant with local speech processing; reply privacy depends on the configured AI backend.
- [TUSK](https://jordysupport.com/tusk/): Free self-hosted sales CRM with optional external integrations.
- [Prompt Academy](https://jordysupport.com/newsletter/): Free newsletter archive and optional email subscription.
- [AI & Technology Services](https://jordysupport.com/consulting/): Help with AI workflows, technology advice, web design, hosting, and SEO. Scope and pricing by email at jordy@jordysupport.com.
